prompt:
Edit this walk-cycle sprite sheet into a mechanically correct natural tired walk. Image 1 is the edit target and exact art/identity/style reference. Preserve the same tired teal-hooded chibi dungeon repairman, brass goggles, brown boots, wrench in right hand, tiny rolling brass toolbox behind him to screen-left, camera, line style, colors, transparent background. Preserve a STRICT 4-column by 3-row grid with exactly TWELVE equally sized 362x362 cells on a 1448x1086 canvas. No numbers/text, no ground/shadows, no cell lines. Each character and toolbox entirely within its own cell with clear margins.

The current legs are incorrect: they repeat one leading foot too often. REDRAW ONLY LEGS/LOWER BODY POSES as TWELVE EVENLY SPACED IN-BETWEENS of ONE COMPLETE TWO-STEP WALK CYCLE. Do not copy the same foot forward for every pose. Feet must visibly alternate, with the nearer/front-layer leg moving BEHIND the hip for the middle half of the cycle while the far leg swings in front. Keep hood/face/wrench/toolbox almost identical across all frames and same x alignment and scale. Head tired, shoulders slouched, low bent-knee shuffling, not running. Toolbox wheels remain exactly on same ground baseline in every cell. Keep total body size/vertical position matched to input. Foot soles stay near the same ground, lifted swing foot max 10 pixels. Figure facing 3/4 right. Think traditional animator's contact/down/passing/up drawings, no pose duplication.

Read left to right top to bottom:
0: NEAR leg reaches forward (right), FAR leg behind (left), heel contact.
1: near foot fully plants right/front, weight lowers slightly, far toe releases behind.
2: near supporting leg starts drifting BACK under hip as body passes; far leg bends and swings forward.
3: legs pass: near support foot below hip, far moving knee just in front, far boot near floor.
4: near support leg BEHIND hip toward LEFT, far leg extends in front toward RIGHT.
5: near heel begins rising at BACK LEFT, far heel almost contacts FRONT RIGHT.
6: OPPOSITE contact to frame0: FAR leg at FRONT RIGHT on ground, NEAR leg extended BACK LEFT, both legs unambiguously visible and crossed.
7: far foot plants front/right, near heel lifts behind/left.
8: far supporting leg moves under hip, near leg bends forward from behind.
9: near swinging leg passes the far supporting leg, near boot near floor under hip.
10: near leg extends forward/right again, far supporting leg moves back/left.
11: near heel almost reaches contact, far toe behind, almost identical to frame0 to close loop smoothly.

IMPORTANT: frame6 MUST show near/front-layer boot to the LEFT of far boot. Frame0 near boot to the RIGHT. Do not generate twelve tiny variations of the same right-leg-forward pose. Keep cartoon identity and upper body stable, do not add extra limbs, no detached parts. Real alpha transparency, clean edges.
